intro.text: One of three islanders on Diggen's Point whose help Tress's plan to get off the island cannot do without.
Owner of Brick's Tavern on Diggen's Point, and brewer of some of the best ale on the Emerald Sea.

items.text: Lem drank at Brick's Tavern often, and Brick knew Tress well. When Lem quietly called in what he was owed, Brick was glad to help: he supplied five barrels of ale for the Oot's Dream plus a sixth with Gret inside, so that a staged failed inspection could get Tress aboard.
When Tress came back to Diggen's Point, she took care to thank Brick and the others who had helped her escape.

appearance.text: A short man who stands on a stool to look his customers in the eye.
